hero.description: Scroll-driven drone cinematic over a Navesink River / Rumson waterfront estate at golden-twilight. Hero opens with a slow boom-out from a wood-shingle gable to a wide aerial crossing the river toward Sandy Hook. Wordmark fades in on second beat. Scroll-scrubbed so frame sequence advances as user scrolls.
hero.geminiPrompt: Cinematic aerial drone photograph at golden hour twilight, slowly booming out from a classic American wood-shingle gabled estate roof to reveal a sweeping wide aerial view of the Navesink River in Monmouth County New Jersey. Foreground: weathered cedar shingles and a copper finial catching the last light. Middle ground: manicured estate gardens, a stone seawall, a private dock with a wooden sailboat moored. Background: the wide silver-blue Navesink River reflecting amber and rose twilight, distant Sandy Hook peninsula on the horizon, a few distant sailboats, soft atmospheric haze. Lighting: warm golden-hour key light from the west, cool cyan ambient from the east, deep navy sky transitioning to peach at the horizon. Color palette: deep navy water, warm cedar browns, champagne gold sunset, soft cream clouds, hint of seafoam in the river. Style: editorial architectural photography in the manner of Architectural Digest meets a Christie's auction catalog cover. Shot on Hasselblad medium format equivalent, 24mm equivalent wide angle, deep depth of field, slight film grain. Painterly clouds, no people, no cars, no text. 16:9 cinematic aspect ratio.
hero.wavespeedMotionPrompt: Slow continuous boom-out and reverse dolly: the camera starts close on the wood-shingle roof gable and copper finial, then rises and pulls back smoothly to reveal the estate, gardens, dock, and the wide Navesink River beyond. Subtle wind ripples on the water surface, gentle sway of distant sailboat masts, soft drift of high cirrus clouds. Atmospheric golden-hour light slowly intensifies. No camera shake. Cinematic, contemplative, prestige real-estate film. 5 seconds.
